speaker: Agent
text: Good morning. May I see your passport and booking confirmation?

speaker: Passenger
text: Here you are. I am flying to London today.

speaker: Agent
text: Thank you. How many bags are you checking in?

speaker: Passenger
text: Just one suitcase. I also have a small backpack for the cabin.

speaker: Agent
text: That is fine. Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?

speaker: Passenger
text: A window seat, please. What time does boarding start?

speaker: Agent
text: Boarding starts at two thirty. Your flight leaves from gate twelve.

speaker: Passenger
text: Do I need to go through security first?

speaker: Agent
text: Yes. Security is on your right. Please be at the gate twenty minutes before departure.

speaker: Passenger
text: Thank you for your help. Have a good day!
